findings.finding: The LOCAL_L3_CONTINUATION.md proof applied the ess-sup bound M_R at specific selected times without justifying the upgrade from an almost-everywhere bound to a bound at those exact times.
findings.repair: Added the lower-semicontinuity argument (G(t) as a supremum of continuous functions) upgrading the ess-sup hypothesis to a pointwise bound at every t in (T-delta,T).

findings.finding: ledger.py raised TypeError when a claim's status field was a malformed unhashable value (list) during the documented-status cross-check.
findings.repair: Guarded the comparison with isinstance(canonical, str); added regression test test_documented_status_check_tolerates_unhashable_status.

findings.finding: _validate_gauntlet_manifest raised IndexError when malformed manifest round entries caused manifest_paths to fall out of index alignment with records/hashes.
findings.repair: Appended a placeholder to manifest_paths in both malformed-entry branches to keep all three lists index-aligned; added regression test test_manifest_tolerates_malformed_entries_without_crashing.

findings.finding: LOCAL-L3-FROM-CKN's statement and counterexample prose claimed the constructed field satisfies the full CKN suitable-solution hypotheses, when it only satisfies the scalar energy inequality.
findings.repair: Narrowed the claim statement, falsification text, and COUNTEREXAMPLES.md prose to scope the refutation to singular-set-measure-zero geometry alone, not PR-07's full hypotheses.

findings.finding: CRITICAL-PROFILE-GAP, CRITICAL-TAIL-TRANSFER, CRITICAL-ORBIT-COMPACT, CRITICAL-TIME-SELECT, LOCAL-L3-FROM-ENERGY, and LOCAL-L3-FROM-CKN listed depends_on values that did not match the prerequisite claims their evidence actually invokes (several pointed at the very target they attack).
findings.repair: Corrected depends_on for all six claims to name the actual prerequisite claims (KNSS-RECORD-PROFILE, AB-L3-ANCIENT, NS-SCALING, ENERGY-SUPERCRITICAL, PR-07, LOCAL-L3-CONTINUATION as appropriate).

findings.finding: OUTCOME.md described deriving the local L3 bound from finite-energy data as the new open estimate, but no ledger claim represented that obligation.
findings.repair: Added blocked claim LOCAL-L3-BOUND-DERIVATION referencing both refuted derivation routes.

findings.finding: README.md and docs/OUTCOME.md stated a stale round count (31, immediately wrong after round 32 was created in the same commit), used broken relative markdown links (docs/research/... from within docs/), described the project as untracked in git, and included an unledgered table row without noting its narrative-only status.
findings.repair: Updated round count to 33, fixed relative links, corrected the tracked-in-git statement, added canonical claim ID annotations to every ledgered Candidate Dispositions row, and flagged the one narrative-only row explicitly.
